name: WooCommerce
one_liner: Free WordPress e-commerce plugin whose REST API lets external systems read and write store data.
auth_notes: Per-store consumer key/secret via Basic Auth over HTTPS (OAuth 1.0a over HTTP). The MCP adapter instead uses WordPress Application Passwords.
access_notes: Self-hosted: store admin generates keys in own WordPress admin; no vendor gate. Requires WooCommerce 3.5+, WordPress 4.4+, pretty permalinks.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free REST API, but every merchant store is a separate self-hosted instance needing its own keys and HTTPS/permalink setup; no sandbox or rate limits documented.

needs_human_reason: Per-store self-hosted setup; sandbox, rate limits and exact endpoint count not documented; MCP is developer preview and needs the MCP Adapter plugin.

identity.quote: You are not required to install the WP REST API (WP API) plugin.

auth.quote: Do not use your account password or a WooCommerce REST API key.

api_surface.quote: Use /wp-json/wc/v3/ endpoints for all new integrations.
The webhooks API allows you to create, view, update, and delete individual, or a batch, of webhooks.

mcp.quote: The MCP implementation in WooCommerce is currently in developer preview.
WooCommerce does not bundle the MCP adapter.

disputes.why: v3 reference lists roughly 25-30 resources (coupons, orders, products, webhooks, settings); exact endpoint count not measured.
